falsification_conditions.condition: SPX closes below 4950 with daily RSI(14) under 30 and VIX closes above 35 for 2 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The 75% pattern match to bottom_2024_aug is broken; August 2024 bottom saw VIX peak at 28.6 and no RSI sustained below 30—this would indicate a liquidation cascade worse than the reference pattern, invalidating the 'bottom' analogue and forcing a capitulation regime change

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops more than 60bps from current level within 14 days while DXY simultaneously rises above 105
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This violates the macro correlation structure of the August 2024 bottom (rates fell with DXY stable-to-lower on growth scare repricing); simultaneous safe-haven bid in bonds AND dollar indicates systemic stress/flight-to-safety that the 'bottom' pattern cannot accommodate—signal would flip from HOLD to full risk-off

falsification_conditions.condition: NYSE advance-decline line makes a new 52-week low while SPX remains above its own 52-week low
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Divergence invalidates the breadth confirmation required for bottom_2024_aug analogue; August bottom saw A-D line and price bottom within 3 days of each other. Persistent negative breadth divergence with price holding up indicates distribution in large-caps masking underlying deterioration—pattern match collapses and 'bottom' call is wrong

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
